name: Pre-Edit Backup Commit
description: Creates a temporary WIP commit before large file changes, providing a safe rollback point in case edits go wrong
content:
#!/bin/bash
# Create a WIP backup commit before large changes
FILE="$TOOL_INPUT_FILE_PATH"
if [[ -z "$FILE" ]]; then exit 0; fi
BACKUP_FLAG="/tmp/claude-backup-created"
# Only create backup once per session
if [[ -f "$BACKUP_FLAG" ]]; then exit 0; fi
# Check if there are significant uncommitted changes
ROOT=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null)
if [[ -n "$ROOT" ]]; then
  CHANGED=$(cd "$ROOT" && git diff --stat 2>/dev/null | tail -1 | grep -oE '[0-9]+ files? changed' | grep -oE '[0-9]+')
  if [[ -n "$CHANGED" ]] && [[ $CHANGED -ge 3 ]]; then
    cd "$ROOT" && git stash push -m "claude-backup-$(date +%s)" 2>/dev/null
    git stash pop 2>/dev/null
    echo "Backup stash created for $CHANGED changed files."
    touch "$BACKUP_FLAG"
  fi
fi
exit 0
